name: DeobfuscateArchives
author: RapidMark
about: Extracts 7z/RAR/ZIP archives that were posted without a file extension.
description: Obfuscated posts sometimes arrive as a single file with a random name and no extension.
NZBGet only unpacks archives it recognises by extension, so these stay packed and Sonarr/Radarr find nothing to import.
This checks extensionless files by their signature, extracts them, and removes the archive once extraction succeeds.
